id.description: Stable key. Referenced by lesson `tools:` frontmatter and <RegistryCard id>. NEVER change it when a product is renamed — change `name` instead.

name.description: Current product name, as shown to learners. This is the field a rebrand changes (e.g. NotebookLM -> Gemini Notebook, July 2026).

docsUrl.description: The documentation link shown to learners.

watchUrl.description: Optional. What scripts/check-sources.mjs reads instead of docsUrl, for vendors whose docs block scripted fetches or who publish a changelog that is a better change signal. Never shown to learners.

tier.description: COVERAGE DEPTH, NOT A QUALITY OR PREFERENCE RANKING. A = general-purpose tools most learners will meet first, given a dedicated lesson. B = significant tools covered within a lesson. C = specialist tools referenced where relevant. Lrnon takes no sponsorship and states no favourite (see docs/brand/philosophy.md); this field decides how much room a tool gets in the curriculum, never whether it is recommended. An undocumented A/B/C reads as a quality ranking, which is why this description exists.
